description: This file defines a static utility class for parsing type names formatted by RuntimeTypeNameFormatter. It contains methods for parsing complex type specifications, including generics, nested types, arrays, pointers, references, and assembly qualifiers, using a custom parsing logic implemented via internal buffer reading structures.
